title: Health insurance claim disputes and policyholder safeguards
asked: Dr Hamid Razak asked whether the Ministry has data on how many health insurance claim disputes were filed with MAS or FIDReC in each of the past three years, what proportion were resolved in favour of policyholders, and whether disputes over claim rejections, exclusions or post-treatment coverage have increased.
response: Mr Alvin Tan said FIDReC completed an average of 246 annual mediation and adjudication claims related to insurance claim liability and amounts awarded between 2022 and 2024, of which an average of 95 were health insurance claims. Independent assessors ruled in favour of policyholders in 4% of health insurance claims. He said disputes and complaints ending up at FIDReC or MAS represent less than 0.01% of all insurance claims, and that MAS expects insurers to pay legitimate claims promptly and can require reviews or repayments if they fall short.

key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: Independent assessors ruled in favour of the policyholders in 4% of the health insurance claims.

key_points.point: Insurers must show that non-disclosure of a health condition was material to the underwriting outcome before rejecting a claim for non-disclosure.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: The onus is on the insurers themselves to demonstrate that the non-disclosure of the health condition to a question asked in the application form is material to the underwriting outcome before they reject a claim for non-disclosure.

key_points.point: MOH and MAS expect insurers to process claims fairly according to policy terms.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: both MOH and MAS expect insurers to process these claims fairly, according to the policy terms.

key_points.point: MAS will take action against insurers who fail to do so.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: MAS will take action against insurers who fail to do so.

key_points.quote: represent less than 0.01% of all insurance claims.

key_points.point: The total number of cases needing adjudication has been dropping over the last few years.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: the total number of cases needing adjudication has been dropping over the last few years.

key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: If an insurer falls short of this, MAS will step in and can require them to review the earlier decision or to pay back the consumer.
